Story of Meerabai
• Watch in Multiple Languages!**
Enjoy this enriching episode in **Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Hindi**! Select your preferred **audio track** from the settings menu and immerse yourself in the timeless wisdom of the Upanishads.
Immerse yourself in the timeless wisdom of *Upanishad Ganga*! Episode 43 unravels the profound philosophy of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas—the three fundamental personality traits—through the inspiring life of *Meerabai*, a fearless devotee of Lord Krishna.
